name: Pam
original_name: パム・ウェルヌ・アサクラ
source:
A half-French girl who travels between France and Japan. She is carefree and her behavior and speech are strange.

She has the dangerous idea of trying to kill Yuu in order to make him her own.

[From [url=http://www.t-apricot.jp/products/aya/chara.html]ApRicoT[/url]]
